kata — keybindings

Global                                 Detail                                            Forms
?         help                         tab/C-j        next tab                           ctrl+o         save or apply
q/ctrl+c  quit                         shift+tab/C-k  prev tab                           esc            cancel
P         projects                     enter          jump to referenced issue           tab/shift+tab  change field
I         inbox                        esc/backspace  back                               ctrl+e         open editor
D         daemons                      e              edit body                          ctrl+u         clear prompt
F         federation                   c              new comment
C         credentials                  R              typed reply to selected comment    Filters
L         toggle layout                ]              next comment link                  /       search
                                       [              previous comment link              s       cycle status filter
Graph                                  p              set parent                         f       filter (form)
k           up                         b              add blocker                        c       clear filters
j           down                       l              add related                        ctrl+r  reset filter form
up/C-p      scroll up                  +              add label
down/C-n    scroll down                -              remove label
pgup/M-v    page up                    a              assign owner
pgdown/C-v  page down                  A              clear owner
g/C-M-<     first                      t              timed assignment
G/C-M->     last                       !              set priority
enter       open detail
space       expand/collapse            Children
right       expand                     N      new child
left        collapse                   j/k    move child cursor
E           expand/collapse all        ↑↓     scroll detail viewport
n           new issue (form)           enter  open child
v           toggle flat/nested view
o           toggle graph order
x           close
r           reopen
u           undo last issue action

press ? to return
